translation.method: editorial translation of supplied Czech catalog

chodovska-tvrz.name: Chodov Fortress
chodovska-tvrz.short: A medieval fortress in the heart of modern Chodov.
chodovska-tvrz.description: Chodov's most distinctive historic landmark began as a medieval moated fortress. Today it is a cultural centre with exhibitions and concerts. Its circular layout and inner courtyard are particularly striking.
chodovska-tvrz.tip: Explore the exterior and check the programme before visiting an exhibition. Admission depends on the event.
chodovska-tvrz.hours: Gallery and ticket office Tue–Sun 13:00–19:00; closed Monday.
chodovska-tvrz.admission: Depends on the exhibition or event; a single admission price has not been verified.
chodovska-tvrz.coordinateNote: Landmark coordinates; confirm the pedestrian gate.

kunraticky-les.name: Kunratice Forest
kunraticky-les.short: Woodland paths and a peaceful escape near Chodov.
kunraticky-les.description: About 284 hectares of woodland offer natural paths, the Kunratice stream valley and the ruins of Nový hrad, associated with King Wenceslas IV. Choose a gentle walk or a longer outing.
kunraticky-les.tip: Some paths are unpaved. Enter at your own risk. Educational stops do not form a continuously marked circular trail.
kunraticky-les.hours: Open natural area without a ticket office.
kunraticky-les.coordinateNote: Centre of a large forest, not a specific entrance.

westfield-chodov.name: Westfield Chodov
westfield-chodov.short: Shopping, restaurants and cinema under one roof.
westfield-chodov.description: A practical choice for shopping, a meal, cinema or a rainy-day programme. Individual businesses inside the shopping centre may keep different hours.
westfield-chodov.tip: Check the opening hours of the particular restaurant, shop or cinema separately.
westfield-chodov.admission: Entry to the centre is free; cinema and other services charge their own prices.
westfield-chodov.coordinateNote: Centre of the shopping building; confirm the appropriate entrance.

jedenactka-vs.name: Jedenáctka VS
jedenactka-vs.short: An indoor swimming and sports complex.
jedenactka-vs.description: This indoor pool and sports complex suits individuals and families. Swimming pools, sports facilities and children's swimming areas have separate spaces.
jedenactka-vs.tip: Check restrictions on public swimming and the current admission price for the length of your visit.
jedenactka-vs.hours: Pool Mon–Fri 6:30–21:00; Sat–Sun and public holidays 8:00–21:00.
jedenactka-vs.admission: Indicative prices from CZK 160 adult / 120 reduced / 340 family according to Prague City Tourism; check the exact ticket type.

toulcuv-dvur.name: Toulcův dvůr
toulcuv-dvur.short: A historic farm, animals and nature for families.
toulcuv-dvur.description: The historic farm in Hostivař offers encounters with animals, nature and educational activities. It is especially suitable for families seeking a quieter day outside the centre.
toulcuv-dvur.tip: The farm and nature area charge admission. Groups larger than 10 have special visiting and booking rules.
toulcuv-dvur.hours: Jan–Feb and Nov–Dec 10:00–16:00; Mar–Jun and Sep–Oct 10:00–18:00; Jul–Aug 9:00–18:00.
toulcuv-dvur.admission: Farm and nature area: adults CZK 60; children from 3, seniors and disability card holders CZK 30; family CZK 130.

hostivarska-prehrada.name: Hostivař Reservoir
hostivarska-prehrada.short: A waterside walk surrounded by green parkland.
hostivarska-prehrada.description: Walk beside the water near Hostivař Forest Park. In summer, the managed beach is a separate paid service; distinguish the beach from the public paths.
hostivarska-prehrada.tip: The beach is seasonal and swimming depends on operation and water quality. Public woodland and the paid beach are different areas.
hostivarska-prehrada.hours: Public paths have no set visiting hours; check the official website for seasonal beach operation.
hostivarska-prehrada.admission: Public paths free. When open: full-day beach CZK 170 adult; seniors, disability card holders and children under 140 cm CZK 110; under 100 cm free. The official website lists the beaches as closed on 8 October 2026.
hostivarska-prehrada.coordinateNote: Coordinates of the main beach complex, not the whole reservoir.

pruhonicky-park.name: Průhonice Park
pruhonicky-park.short: A UNESCO-listed landscape park around a château.
pruhonicky-park.description: Romantic paths, ponds and botanical scenery surround Průhonice Château. Allow half a day, especially during rhododendron flowering or autumn colours.
pruhonicky-park.tip: This is not a short walk from the hotel. Take public transport or a taxi to the park, then explore on foot. Tickets are also checked inside.
pruhonicky-park.hours: Daily: Jan–Feb and Nov–Dec 8:00–17:00; Mar 7:00–18:00; Apr and Oct 7:00–19:00; May–Sep 7:00–20:00.
pruhonicky-park.admission: Adults CZK 160; reduced CZK 110; family CZK 430; dog CZK 50.
pruhonicky-park.coordinateNote: Château near the main park entrance; confirm the turnstile.

dendrologicka-zahrada.name: Průhonice Dendrological Garden
dendrologicka-zahrada.short: Seasonal flowers, trees and beautiful garden compositions.
dendrologicka-zahrada.description: The garden specialises in collections of trees, shrubs, perennials and landscape design. A pleasant option for plant lovers and families, with highlights changing through the seasons.
dendrologicka-zahrada.tip: The 2026 season ends on 8 November. Last admission is one hour before closing.
dendrologicka-zahrada.hours: Season approximately March–8 November. Apr and Oct Tue–Sun 9:00–18:00; May–Aug Tue–Sun 9:00–19:00; Sep Tue–Sun 9:00–18:00; 1–8 Nov 9:00–17:00.
dendrologicka-zahrada.admission: Adults CZK 150; reduced CZK 100; family CZK 350.
dendrologicka-zahrada.coordinateNote: Official coordinates of the car park and main entrance.

aquapalace-praha.name: Aquapalace Praha
aquapalace-praha.short: Water slides, pools and relaxation in Čestlice.
aquapalace-praha.description: Water World offers slides, pools, a wild river and family attractions. It makes a full-day programme in bad weather. Sauna and wellness access may cost extra.
aquapalace-praha.tip: Water World tickets differ from combined Sauna + Water World tickets. Prices vary by day and online purchase.
aquapalace-praha.hours: Water World Mon–Wed 10:00–20:00; Thu–Fri 10:00–22:00; Sat 9:00–22:00; Sun 9:00–20:00, except special dates.
aquapalace-praha.admission: Water World only: adults Mon–Thu 3 hours CZK 1,049 / day CZK 1,149; Fri–Sun and public holidays 3 hours CZK 1,299 / day CZK 1,399.
aquapalace-praha.coordinateNote: Official complex coordinates; confirm pedestrian doors.

hamersky-rybnik.name: Hamerský Pond and HAMR Záběhlice
hamersky-rybnik.short: Waterside views with sports facilities nearby.
hamersky-rybnik.description: Záběhlice combines a walk beside the pond with tennis, squash or a restaurant stop. It is a quieter urban outing with optional sports.
hamersky-rybnik.tip: The public pond walk is separate from paid sports facilities. Book sports according to the operator's rules.
hamersky-rybnik.hours: Public pond paths freely accessible; HAMR sports complex daily 7:00–23:00.
hamersky-rybnik.admission: Public walk free; sports and food according to the operator's current price list.
hamersky-rybnik.coordinateNote: Centre of the pond, not a pedestrian entrance; choose an access path.

prazsky-hrad.name: Prague Castle
prazsky-hrad.short: Royal history and magnificent views above the Vltava.
prazsky-hrad.description: Explore the extensive historic grounds with St Vitus Cathedral, the Old Royal Palace, St George's Basilica and Golden Lane. Courtyards are accessible separately from ticketed interiors.
prazsky-hrad.tip: Walking through the grounds and entering buildings are different activities. Security checks and exceptional closures may apply.
prazsky-hrad.hours: Grounds daily 6:00–22:00; visitor buildings Apr–Oct 9:00–17:00, Nov–Mar 9:00–16:00.
prazsky-hrad.admission: Main circuit CZK 450; reduced CZK 300; family CZK 950. Public access through the grounds does not require this ticket.
prazsky-hrad.coordinateNote: Centre of the extensive castle grounds; several entrances.

karluv-most.name: Charles Bridge
karluv-most.short: A Gothic stone bridge with views towards the castle.
karluv-most.description: The statue-lined bridge crosses the Vltava between the Old Town and Malá Strana. Early morning and evening offer a special atmosphere and views of towers and riverside buildings.
karluv-most.tip: Crossing the bridge is free. The neighbouring bridge towers charge separate admission.
karluv-most.hours: Public pedestrian bridge without set visiting hours.
karluv-most.coordinateNote: Coordinates approximately in the middle of the bridge.

staromestska-radnice.name: Old Town Hall and Astronomical Clock
staromestska-radnice.short: Historic interiors, the famous clock and a panoramic tower.
staromestska-radnice.description: Founded in the 14th century, the Old Town Hall and its astronomical clock are among Prague's best-known landmarks. The tower offers panoramic views and the visitor circuit includes historic rooms.
staromestska-radnice.tip: Watching the exterior clock is free; tower and building admission is paid.
staromestska-radnice.admission: Interior circuit CZK 350; reduced CZK 230; family CZK 750. Lift and guided tours cost extra.

staromestska-mostecka-vez.name: Old Town Bridge Tower
staromestska-mostecka-vez.short: A Gothic gateway overlooking Charles Bridge.
staromestska-mostecka-vez.description: The ceremonial gateway to Charles Bridge is a Gothic monument associated with Charles IV. Approximately 138 steps lead to the viewing gallery.
staromestska-mostecka-vez.tip: The bridge entrance is free; the tower viewing gallery is paid. Step-free access is limited.
staromestska-mostecka-vez.admission: Adults CZK 250; reduced CZK 170; family CZK 500.

klementinum.name: Klementinum: Astronomical Tower and Baroque Library
klementinum.short: A magnificent library and tower in a Baroque complex.
klementinum.description: Join an organised tour to see the monumental library hall and climb the astronomical tower above the historic centre. Tour capacity is limited.
klementinum.tip: The library is viewed under the tour's rules, not as an open reading room. Advance e-tickets are recommended.
klementinum.admission: Adults CZK 380; reduced CZK 230; family CZK 810.

josefov.name: Josefov: Jewish Museum and Synagogues
josefov.short: Historic synagogues and the Old Jewish Cemetery.
josefov.description: The Jewish Museum comprises several sites in Prague's former Jewish quarter. A combined ticket includes historic synagogues and the cemetery, offering a culturally and historically significant visit.
josefov.tip: Closed on Saturdays and Jewish holidays. The Old-New Synagogue may have different hours, particularly on Friday.
josefov.hours: 1 Sep–17 Oct 2026 9:00–18:00; 18 Oct–31 Dec 2026 9:00–16:30. Closed Saturdays and selected holidays.
josefov.admission: Prague Jewish Town circuit: adults CZK 600; students under 26 CZK 400; children 6–15 CZK 200.
josefov.coordinateNote: Museum coordinates; confirm entrance and ticket office.

petrinska-rozhledna.name: Petřín Lookout Tower
petrinska-rozhledna.short: A hilltop panorama over the whole city.
petrinska-rozhledna.description: The steel tower stands in Petřín's gardens and offers striking views of Prague. Combine the visit with a walk through the greenery and nearby gardens.
petrinska-rozhledna.tip: Expect stairs. Lift use costs extra; check current availability.
petrinska-rozhledna.hours: Oct approximately daily 9:00–18:00; Jan–Mar and Nov–Dec 10:00–18:00; other months according to the official website.
petrinska-rozhledna.admission: Adults CZK 250; reduced CZK 170; family CZK 500; lift extra.

vysehrad.name: Vyšehrad
vysehrad.short: Ancient walls, legends and peaceful river views.
vysehrad.description: The historic fortified site includes parks, the Romanesque Rotunda of St Martin, the Basilica of St Peter and St Paul and Slavín Cemetery. A quieter walk with beautiful views.
vysehrad.tip: The park is freely accessible. Casemates, exhibitions and guided tours charge separately.
vysehrad.hours: Park grounds open year-round; information centre usually 10:00–12:00 and 13:00–18:00.
vysehrad.admission: Public paths free; selected buildings charge according to the programme.
vysehrad.coordinateNote: Public entrance of the grounds, documented by official source.

narodni-muzeum.name: National Museum
narodni-muzeum.short: History and natural sciences beside Wenceslas Square.
narodni-muzeum.description: The Historical and New Buildings form one visitor complex. Exhibitions cover history and natural sciences, making the museum a good rainy-day choice.
narodni-muzeum.tip: The Museum Complex ticket does not include some separate exhibitions or the Children's Museum.
narodni-muzeum.admission: Museum Complex: adults CZK 360; reduced CZK 260; accompanied children under 15 free.

narodni-technicke-muzeum.name: National Technical Museum
narodni-technicke-muzeum.short: Transport, inventions and the history of technology.
narodni-technicke-muzeum.description: The museum on Letná explores transport, industry and technological development. Its extensive exhibitions appeal to families and visitors interested in technology and design.
narodni-technicke-muzeum.tip: The ore and coal mine exhibition has a separate supplementary admission arrangement.
narodni-technicke-muzeum.hours: Closed Monday; usually other days 9:00–18:00. Check exceptions.
narodni-technicke-muzeum.admission: Main building: adults CZK 330; reduced CZK 200; children 6–15 CZK 80; family CZK 680.

zoo-praha.name: Prague Zoo
zoo-praha.short: A full day of animals and outdoor exploration in Troja.
zoo-praha.description: Prague Zoo has many exhibits across a large natural outdoor site. Allow several hours and expect hilly terrain.
zoo-praha.tip: Some pavilions and entrances close earlier. October closing changes when daylight-saving time ends.
zoo-praha.hours: Oct 9:00–17:00, then until 16:00 after the clocks change; Nov–Feb 9:00–16:00; other months seasonal.
zoo-praha.admission: At the gate: adults CZK 330; children 3–15 CZK 250; family (2 adults and up to 4 children) CZK 1,000. Online tickets are cheaper.
zoo-praha.coordinateNote: Official entrance coordinates of the zoo.

botanicka-troja.name: Prague Botanical Garden, Troja
botanicka-troja.short: Outdoor gardens, Fata Morgana greenhouse and a vineyard.
botanicka-troja.description: Explore varied outdoor plant collections and a tropical greenhouse. The garden's highlights change with the seasons and exhibitions.
botanicka-troja.tip: The Fata Morgana greenhouse closes on Monday although the outdoor gardens remain open.
botanicka-troja.hours: Outdoor gardens Mar–Oct daily 9:00–19:00; Nov–Feb 9:00–16:00. Fata Morgana Tue–Sun.
botanicka-troja.admission: At the gate: adults CZK 180; children 3–15 CZK 120; family CZK 540. Online CZK 150 / 100 / 450.

obecni-dum.name: Municipal House
obecni-dum.short: Art Nouveau splendour beside the Powder Tower.
obecni-dum.description: One of Prague's finest Art Nouveau buildings has richly decorated interiors. Visit the café or take a guided tour of the ceremonial rooms.
obecni-dum.tip: Tours and concerts have their own schedules; ticket office hours do not describe all interior spaces.
obecni-dum.hours: Ticket office daily 10:00–19:00; tours according to the schedule.
obecni-dum.admission: Guided tour CZK 320; reduced CZK 270; family CZK 660.

valdstejnska-zahrada.name: Wallenstein Garden
valdstejnska-zahrada.short: Baroque geometry, peacocks and a grand sala terrena.
valdstejnska-zahrada.description: One of Malá Strana's most beautiful historic gardens. Carefully framed views, an artificial grotto wall and peacocks invite a short visit.
valdstejnska-zahrada.tip: The garden is outside its main visiting season in winter. Check the specific entrance gate.

zahrady-prazskeho-hradu.name: Prague Castle Gardens
zahrady-prazskeho-hradu.short: Garden terraces, fountains and views towards the centre.
zahrady-prazskeho-hradu.description: The Royal Garden and accessible southern gardens combine Renaissance, Baroque and later landscape design. A pleasant stop during a castle visit.
zahrady-prazskeho-hradu.tip: Hartig Garden is inaccessible. Other gardens are seasonal and may close exceptionally.
zahrady-prazskeho-hradu.coordinateNote: Garden area, not a specific pedestrian entrance.

zizkovska-vez.name: Žižkov Television Tower
zizkovska-vez.short: A modern viewpoint high above Prague.
zizkovska-vez.description: Žižkov's 216-metre landmark has viewing areas well above the city's rooftops. David Černý's well-known baby sculptures climb its structure.
zizkovska-vez.tip: The observation deck and restaurant are separate operations; event hours may differ.
zizkovska-vez.hours: Daily 9:00–24:00 according to Prague City Tourism.
zizkovska-vez.admission: Observation deck CZK 350; reduced CZK 250; family CZK 750.

zahrady-pod-hradem.name: Palace Gardens below Prague Castle
zahrady-pod-hradem.short: Historic terraces and romantic corners on the southern slope.
zahrady-pod-hradem.description: Several connected palace gardens offer architecture, staircases and viewpoints for a quieter outing away from the main crowds.
zahrady-pod-hradem.tip: Enter from Valdštejnská Street. Direct access to Prague Castle may be closed. Closed during adverse weather.
zahrady-pod-hradem.hours: Apr and Oct daily 10:00–18:00; May–Sep daily 10:00–19:00; seasonal.
zahrady-pod-hradem.coordinateNote: Garden grounds; confirm entrance from Valdštejnská Street.

letenske-sady.name: Letná Park
letenske-sady.short: A leafy park with a panorama of Prague's bridges.
letenske-sady.description: Popular Letná Park offers long walking paths, places to rest and views across the Vltava to the historic centre. Combine it with the National Technical Museum.
letenske-sady.tip: Restaurants, attractions and the historic carousel have separate operating rules.
letenske-sady.coordinateNote: Centre of the public park; choose a pedestrian approach.

tancici-dum.name: Dancing House and Gallery
tancici-dum.short: Distinctive modern architecture beside the Vltava.
tancici-dum.description: Designed by Vlado Milunić and Frank Gehry, the Dancing House is one of Prague's best-known modern buildings. Admire its unusual forms outside or visit an exhibition inside.
tancici-dum.tip: Photograph the exterior from the riverside without a ticket. Gallery and possible viewpoint access have separate rules.
tancici-dum.admission: Exterior free; gallery CZK 230; reduced CZK 185; family CZK 600.

chodov-klid.name: A peaceful walk around Chodov
chodov-klid.start: Hotel or a manually selected point
chodov-klid.notes: An indicative local itinerary. Walking connections and distances must be verified by routing and a physical walk.

kunratice-priroda.name: Kunratice woodland escape
kunratice-priroda.start: Approved pedestrian entrance to the forest
kunratice-priroda.notes: A woodland outing without an invented circular route. Check that the actual paths are accessible.

stare-mesto.name: An afternoon in the historic centre
stare-mesto.notes: Travel to the centre by public transport or taxi. The itinerary covers only the walking section; interior visits are optional.

mala-strana-hrad.name: Prague Castle and Malá Strana
mala-strana-hrad.start: Prague Castle, an approved entrance gate
mala-strana-hrad.notes: Garden connections are seasonal and some direct passages are closed. Check current openings.

letna-technika.name: Letná and technology
letna-technika.notes: Suitable for a museum visit in bad weather; the outdoor section depends on conditions.
